responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend AST pretty-printer/debug dumper by defining `AST::Dump`, a concrete `ASTVisitor` that walks crate, item, expression, statement, pattern, type, path, and macro nodes and writes Rust-like source text to an output stream. It owns the traversal helpers for indentation, line/block formatting, separator-joined lists, and per-node textual emission, so it is the executable side of AST dumping rather than the AST model itself; it consumes already-built AST nodes and produces human-readable diagnostic/debug output.
same_name_distinction: Implements the concrete behavior declared in rust-ast-dump.h: the out-of-line `Indent` methods and the many `AST::Dump::visit`/formatting routines that actually traverse AST nodes and emit Rust-like text. Unlike the paired header, this `.cc` is the executable printer logic rather than the interface declaration.
